inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite nonnegative cadence in steps per minute for an already-constructed activPAL minute.
outputBoundary: Classify a minute as MVPA at cadence equal to or above 100 steps per minute and as below MVPA below that boundary.
limitations: The proprietary activPAL algorithm, raw 20 Hz acceleration processing, minute construction, cadence derivation, and wear-time classification occur upstream.
This binding classifies one already-constructed minute; summing classified minutes into daily MVPA duration occurs downstream.
No cadence rounding, step-event definition, partial-minute handling, or imputation behavior is inferred.
The setting is shared physical-activity preprocessing for a mixed-platform analysis and does not imply Android-derived activPAL measurements.
Missing, negative, or nonfinite cadence fails closed rather than being interpreted as sedentary or zero.
